mapper.select: SELECT A.J_BNUM AS CAR_NO , CAST(CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.SECONDWEIGHT ELSE A.FIRSTWEIGHT END AS NUMERIC) AS WEIGHT , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHER ELSE A.J_COMPANY END AS DEALER , A.KERATYPE AS DEAL_GB , CAST(A.JUNPYOID AS NUMERIC) AS JUNPYOID FROM MESURING A WHERE A.KERATYPE <> '직송' AND (A.J_SERIAL = 0 OR A.J_SERIAL IS NULL) ORDER BY SUN
